description:
Create a single chart window in NinjaTrader 8 containing three distinct tabs: one for SPY, one for AAPL, and one for MSFT. Ensure all three tabs are set to a Daily timeframe. Save the workspace when complete. 

Starting state: NinjaTrader 8 is open with no charts. 
Expected result: A single window with 3 tabs (SPY, AAPL, MSFT) saved to disk.
